scope: Curated paraphrases; reported results, not E2 experiments or final eligibility.

studies.version: Published PDF in institutional repository; online 2025, volume 2026.
studies.target: BitVol implied volatility index with 30-day tenor. Forecast horizon is one day or mean of next five days, not a 30-day forecast.
studies.reported_result: Table 3: one-day LSTM RMSPE 5.70%, RMSE 3.13; TGARCH 10.51%, 5.83. Table 5: five-day DM comparison versus TGARCH p=0.053, not significant at 5%.
studies.limits: Different target from E2 realized-return volatility; missing-value interpolation and timing require audit. Reported 1745 days versus 1395 train +349 test remains unresolved.

studies.version: SSRN 4247684 preprint, 7 October 2022, 53 pages. Author links it to IEEE DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3584243; editorial 2025 equivalence is NOT verified.
studies.target: Annualized return-dispersion proxy, fourth-root transformed; spike classification additionally conditions on positive return. Window N not resolved.
studies.reported_result: Preprint table 3: Synthesizer FD RMSE 0.101 and F1 0.463; LSTM RMSE 0.095 and F1 0.171; vanilla Transformer RMSE 0.095 and F1 0.286. Higher spike F1 is not lower forecast RMSE.
studies.locator: Preprint printed pp. 16–18 equations 4–5, p. 22 split; printed p. 26 (PDF file page 27), table 3.
studies.limits: Compare editorial version before attributing numbers to IEEE 2025. Counts 46 versus 60 spikes conflict; early missing values imputed zero. No replication.

studies.target: One-day conditional volatility, lookback 30; proxy described as model-implied in section 3.2 and based on realized returns in 4.1. Exact construction unresolved.
studies.reported_result: Editorial HTML describes regime-dependent comparisons of standalone LSTM, GARCH and hybrids. No exact table values are reproduced here because the independent verification could not retrieve the PDF table.
studies.locator: Editorial HTML, sections 3.1–3.2 and 4.1; equation 5. Numerical table extraction pending independent verification.
studies.limits: Daily Bitcoin only; small crisis subsamples and regime-dependent winners. Audit proxy, rolling initialization and supplement/code before reproduction.
